concepts.definition: Employee job responsibility and functional title
User RBAC access permissions and security profile

resolutions.reason: The term conflates HR job responsibilities with system access control permissions.

concepts.definition: Origin or destination physical location for a move
Contact or billing location associated with a customer

resolutions.reason: Addresses serve distinct purposes: logistical endpoints for moves versus customer contact/billing data.

concepts.definition: Core moving and relocation service offering
Additional services such as cleaning or box rental

resolutions.reason: Moving is the core service, while cleaning and rentals are ancillary offerings with different operational handling.

concepts.definition: Contracts, insurance policies, and compliance evidence
Proof of delivery, manifests, and operational records

resolutions.reason: Legal/compliance documents require different retention and access controls than operational proof.

concepts.definition: Record of customer communications, support tickets, and sales interactions
Technical version history and system audit logs

resolutions.reason: Customer interaction history is business data, while system history is technical audit/versioning data.

concepts.definition: Assignment of specific tasks or shifts to employees for payroll tracking
Allocation of crews, vehicles, or equipment to a specific move

resolutions.reason: Job assignments relate to employee labor and payroll, while resource allocation relates to logistical fulfillment.
